skos:definition: Relates a FailureCause (e.g., parameter excursion, environmental condition, machine state) to a PCB unit or lot whose qualities or behavior are altered as a consequence. Use when the cause has process‑level provenance and the board is the bearer of the effect.
skos:example: FailureCause: ThermalGradientAcrossBoard (derived from reflow oven thermocouple array and PLC logs) affects PCB Lot L2025‑W45‑P12 (panels observed with skew/tombstoning events).

skos:definition: Links a CorrectiveAction specification to the FailureCause it is designed to eliminate or mitigate. The action targets the causal mechanism, not only the observed symptom.
skos:example: CorrectiveAction: ReflowProfileRetune (reduce peak to 245 °C; TAL 70–80 s per IPC‑7530 profile) corrects FailureCause: PeakReflowTemperature (excess peak detected by inline thermocouples and oven controller logs).

skos:definition: Associates a PCB instance with a Defect that inheres in that board. This is the placement relation used when inspection or test confirms the defect on a specific unit/panel.
skos:example: PCB Unit U‑000123 defectOccursOn SolderBridging between pads of device U1 (defect confirmed by post‑reflow AOI image and ICT continuity test).

skos:definition: Connects a ConformanceAssessment activity to any Information Content Entity used as evidence—including SPI/AOI datasets, X‑ray images, MES/ERP travelers, SPC charts, machine/PLC logs, and sensor streams.
skos:example: ConformanceAssessment: COA‑PCB1‑paste_volume_rule hasAssessmentInput SPI_3D_Deposit_Map (CSV+images), Oven_Profile_TCs (JSON), and Printer_Setup_Log (CSV).

skos:definition: States that a specific PCB bears a Defect; the defect is realized on that unit as determined by inspection/test.
skos:example: PCB Lot L2025‑W45‑P12 hasDefect OpenSolderJoint on J3 pin 5 (diagnosed by functional test failure corroborated by X‑ray voiding pattern).

skos:definition: Links a PCB to a ParameterObservation record that describes a measured attribute of that unit—including numeric value, unit, method, timestamp, and provenance (sensor, inline metrology, machine log, control system).
skos:example: PCB Unit U‑000123 hasObservation PasteVolume_PadU1_17 = 0.050 mm³ (from 3D‑SPI file; includes camera ID, calibration, and timestamp).

skos:definition: Inverse of affects. Declares that a PCB’s realized state was influenced by a named FailureCause determined via causal analysis over multi‑modal evidence.
skos:example: PCB Panel P‑019 isAffectedBy LowPasteViscosity (inferred from rheometer logs, printer torque telemetry, and increased post‑print spread observed by vision system).

skos:definition: Inverse of hasAssessmentInput. Indicates that a data artifact (document, image, log, sensor file) serves as input evidence to a specific ConformanceAssessment activity.
skos:example: Oven_Profile_TCs_2025‑11‑05.json isAssessmentInputFor COA‑PCB1‑paste_volume_rule (profile used to validate TAL window before rule evaluation).

skos:definition: Inverse of corrects. Associates a FailureCause with the CorrectiveAction that addresses the causal mechanism through parameter/spec updates, maintenance, or method change.
skos:example: FailureCause: LowAreaRatio isCorrectedBy StencilRedesign (increase AAR ≥ 0.66; CAM rev and fab drawing updated).

skos:definition: Inverse of hasObservation. Binds a ParameterObservation to the PCB it describes, preserving traceability from measured value back to unit and its data provenance.
skos:example: PasteViscosityObs_170Pa·s@25 °C observationOf PCB Lot L2025‑W45 (value computed from rheometer data file with method metadata).
